About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Carpenter / Cabinet Maker to join our team on a full-time basis. The successful candidate will be responsible for carrying out cabinetry, installation, repair, and maintenance works within residential properties managed by the company.

The role will focus on light kitchen upgrades, cabinet installation, shelving, storage units, furniture installation, doors, trims, internal fittings, minor repairs, and property improvement works required to prepare and maintain co-living houses.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

? ?Measuring, cutting, assembling, and installing timber, laminate, flat-pack, and prefabricated cabinetry components.
? ?Installing and adjusting kitchen cabinets, benchtops, cupboard doors, handles, hinges, drawers, shelving, wardrobes, storage units, and internal fittings.
? ?Completing light kitchen renovation works, including cabinet replacement, fitting adjustments, repairs, and installation of storage solutions.
? ?Installing and repairing doors, skirting boards, architraves, trims, shelves, fixtures, and fittings.
? ?Assembling and installing furniture and built-in storage for rooms and common areas.
? ?Repairing or replacing damaged cabinetry, timber fittings, doors, shelving, and fixtures.
? ?Reading and interpreting measurements, job instructions, product specifications, and site requirements.
? ?Selecting appropriate materials, tools, fixings, and methods for each job.
? ?Supporting property setup works in company-managed co-living properties.
? ?Ensuring all work is completed safely, neatly, and to a professional standard.
? ?Coordinating with maintenance coordinators, painters, cleaners, suppliers, and other trades where required.
? ?Maintaining tools, equipment, and work areas in a safe and organised condition.
? ?Reporting job progress, materials used, and any site issues to management.
? ?Complying with workplace health and safety requirements and company procedures.
Skills and Experience Required

The successful candidate must have:

? ?Minimum 1 year of full-time relevant experience as a Carpenter, Cabinet Maker, Joiner, or similar role, or equivalent pro-rata part-time experience.
? ?Experience with kitchen cabinetry, cabinet installation, furniture installation, shelving, timber repairs, internal fittings, or residential carpentry works.
? ?Ability to measure, cut, assemble, and install cabinetry and timber components accurately.
? ?Ability to use carpentry and cabinetry tools and equipment safely.
? ?Good understanding of residential property setup, repairs, and maintenance requirements.
? ?Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
? ?Strong attention to detail and ability to complete work to a high standard.
? ?Good communication and time management skills.
? ?White Card or willingness to obtain one.
? ?Relevant trade qualification, Certificate III, or Recognition of Prior Learning in Carpentry or Cabinet Making will be highly regarded.

Desirable
?Experience working in residential maintenance, light renovations, kitchen upgrades, property setups, or accommodation-related environments.
?Experience installing kitchens, cabinets, wardrobes, shelving, doors, trims, and furniture.
?Driver’s licence and ability to travel between company-managed properties.
?Ability to coordinate with suppliers and other trades on-site.

•	Finishing products by cleaning, polishing, and filing to a high standard prior to dispatch or installation.
•	Performing routine maintenance on equipment and tools to ensure they are in good working condition.
•	Following all safety protocols and procedures to maintain a safe working environment for yourself and others.
•	Reading and interpreting technical drawings, blueprints, and specifications to guide the fabrication and installation processes.
•	Working closely with other team members, including project supervisors, to ensure project requirements are met.
•	Maintaining a safe and organised work environment, adhering to all relevant health and safety regulations.
•	Site installation of fabricated metal work.

•	Relevant Qualification or 3 years of experience in lieu of the qualification.

We are a family-owned industry leader specializing in manufacturing quality feed supplements for primary producers. We are currently looking for full-time Mill Operators in our North Melbourne Feed Mill. 

This position is responsible for operating equipment required for the manufacture of stockfeed. Full training provided. The position is full time, Monday to Friday with an immediate start. Our North Melbourne Mill is close to public transport and on-site parking is available.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Operating feed manufacturing equipment, ingredient mixing, measuring and batching.
Driving front end loaders, telehandlers and forklifts 
Working safely and efficiently to meet daily production and quality targets.
Inventory management including weighbridge duties, warehousing and loading
Monitoring and testing grain and feed quality
Cleaning and maintaining equipment
Adhering to OH&S policies

MINIMUM SKILL LEVELS AND EXPERIENCE
Experience operating front end loader 
Current forklift license and drivers license 
Experience in trades, feed mill or manufacturing environment a distinct advantage
Mechanical aptitude an advantage
Physically fit to undertake manual tasks
Good written communication and computer skills (especially Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook)
Sound knowledge of OH&S and environmental policies and legislation
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends and/or overtime hours as required
High level of attention to detail, ability to work in a team and under pressure

BENEFITS
Competitive remuneration
Full time
Immediate start
Training and development opportunities
On-Site parking

Shortlisted candidates may be required to undertake pre-employment medical (inc. drug and alcohol testing). Open to applicants with unrestricted rights to work in Australia. Only successful candidates will be contacted.  Previous applicants need not apply.
